summary.text: Frank Morano represents the 51st District on the New York City Council, which covers Staten Island's South Shore, including Great Kills, Tottenville, Annadale and Eltingville.
His Council biography says he won three elections in 2025: an April special election, a June primary and the November general election.

paragraphs.text: Morano is a lifelong Staten Islander who, according to his Council biography, spent many years working in television and radio, covering government and public policy.
He previously served on the staff of Council Member Joe Borelli and has served on Staten Island Community Board 3 since 2013.
His legislative work includes measures on public transparency, transportation and traffic management, and resolutions urging expanded statewide access to fertility treatment tax credits.
